candidates.title: Plan a self-hosted email setup

demandEvidence.chore: I wanted to self host my email and decided to rent a VPS.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I wanted to self host my email and decided to rent a VPS.

ease.reason: A student could test a small mail-server setup on a rented test host, but no implementation reference documents the setup.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent professionals may pay for mail setup help; this personal request proves no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test could configure a disposable domain, but deliverability, security and ongoing maintenance are unresolved.

autonomy.reason: Monitoring could flag test failures, but mail security, reputation and remediation need continuing human oversight.

evidence.reason: The request directly states self-hosting email and renting a VPS, but gives no workflow detail, recurrence or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: the request supports only an untested personal mail-hosting setup, with no implementation reference, recurring workflow or paying-customer evidence.
